answer.title: Automate Supplier Bill Entry
answer.trigger: An email arrives with a new supplier invoice notification from Hot Water Hub.
steps: Read the incoming supplier invoice email.
Extract the invoice reference, amount, and due date.
Draft a new supplier bill entry in the accounts system.
Wait for human approval to avoid entering incorrect payment details.
Publish the bill into the accounts system.
answer.ai_help: Extracting the invoice reference, amount, and due date from the email text.
answer.human_approval: Emma reviews and approves the drafted supplier bill before it is finally saved in the accounts system.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, incorrect bills or amounts could be entered into the financial accounts.
